pin.reason: Mirror bytes pinned; original-study identity unestablished.

method: FroDock 3.12 GNU MPI, published PINDER adapter
build_commands_internal:
apt-get --allow-releaseinfo-change update \
    && apt-get -y install --no-install-recommends \
    apt-utils \
    dialog 2>&1 \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    git \
    rsync \
    ssh \
    gpg \
    wget \
    man-db \
    procps \
    tree \
    unzip \
    gcc \
    build-essential \
    lsb-release \
    curl \
    vim \
    exuberant-ctags \
    apt-transport-https \
    ca-certificates \
    gnupg \
    libgl1-mesa-glx  \
    libopenblas-base \
    libopenmpi-dev openmpi-common openmpi-bin libopenmpi3 \
    libfftw3-3 libfftw3-dev libfftw3-mpi-dev \
    libhdf5-openmpi-dev \
    && apt-get autoclean \
    && apt-get autoremove \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

micromamba install -y -n base -c conda-forge \
    pyopenssl=23.2.0 \
    python=${MAMBA_PYTHON_VERSION} \
    requests=2.25.1 \
    google-cloud-storage \
    gcsfs \
    keyrings.google-artifactregistry-auth \
    && micromamba clean --all --yes

echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/cloud.google.gpg] http://packages.cloud.google.com/apt cloud-sdk main" | tee -a /etc/apt/sources.list.d/google-cloud-sdk.list && curl https://packages.cloud.google.com/apt/doc/apt-key.gpg | apt-key --keyring /usr/share/keyrings/cloud.google.gpg  add - && apt-get update -y && apt-get install google-cloud-cli -y

python -m pip install \
    simple-gcp-object-downloader \
    kubernetes \
    pandas==1.5.3

git clone https://github.com/pinder-org/pinder.git; \
    cd pinder && pip install .

tar -xf frodock.tar.gz && \
    mv frodock3_linux64 frodock && \
    rm frodock.tar.gz
run_commands: pinder_methods predict -m <method> -s <test set> -l <list of PINDER ids> -c `config` -r `results_dir`
run_command_notes: Exact published command templates, not executed; methods README short flags conflict with Fire signature. Use source function signatures when repairing runner. FroDock mirror run_frodock.sh offers direct published execution path.

published_configuration.docking_options: --th 10 -t A; receptor W/E/DS and ligand DS maps; bin/soap.bin
published_configuration.n_solutions_reason: Required adapter parameter; no published fixed count for this workload established.

reproduction_risks: main.py calls nonexistent pandas.from_csv; documented short CLI flags differ from Fire function names.
predict.py uses Path concatenation without slash in binary/scoring paths; does not copy input PDBs to temporary workdir; shutil.copy receives literal wildcard; subprocess return codes unchecked.
Dockerfile copies archive to /workspace but extracts from /root/workspace and sets PATH to /app/frodock/bin; dependency resolution unpinned.
Published code needs review and repair before usable end-to-end run; no repair or workload executed during intake.
provenance: unverified_mirror allowed by owner for local experiment; original study equivalence remains conditional.
